timeline.summary: Styrenix Performance Materials Limited scheduled an earnings call for Q4 & FY2026 results on May 16, 2026, at 4:00 PM IST with Managing Director Rahul Agrawal, CFO Bhupesh Porwal, and Manager Legal Chintan Doshi.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹826.1 Cr, net profit ₹73.48 Cr.
Styrenix Performance Materials reported Q4FY26 standalone revenue of ₹658 Cr (-6.3% YoY) and EBITDA of ₹126 Cr (+51.9% YoY) during its earnings call on May 16, 2026.
Styrenix Performance Materials Limited has organized an Earnings Call for its unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for Q2 & H1 FY27 on Thursday, 29th October 2026 at 3:00 PM IST.
